name: 陳錦文
objective:
本課程旨在介紹各種高分子加工成型技術及其相關知識，使同學瞭解各種高分子加工技術的特性，加工原理及方法。主要講授內容為高分子材料的特性、高分子製品各種性質的檢驗方法、高分子材料的流變性質、高分子材料的混合與摻合問題、介紹塑膠材料的各種加工成型技術及介紹纖維成型技術。
This course aims to introduce various polymer processing and molding technologies and related knowledge to understand the characteristics of various polymer processing technologies, processing principles, and methods of suitable polymer materials. The main lectures are the characteristics of polymer materials, the inspection methods of various properties of polymer products, the rheological properties of polymer materials, the mixing and blending of polymer materials, the introduction of different processing and molding technologies of plastic materials, and the introduction of fibers processing technology.
schedule:
1.	Introduction (課程導論)
2.	Physical Basis of Polymer Processing (高分子加工基礎)
3.	Introduction to Polymer Rheology (基礎高分子流變學)
4.	Mixing and Blending (混合與摻合)
5.	Extrusion (擠壓成型)
6.	Injection Molding (射出成型)
7.	Blow molding (吹壓成型)
8.	Compression Molding (熱壓成型)
9.	Fiber Reinforced Plastics and Composites (纖維增強塑膠與複合材料)
10.	Fiber Spinning (纖維工藝)
materials:
1、	Polymer Processing, 1st ed., D. H. Morton-Jones, Springer, 1989
2、	Introduction to physical polymer science (L. H. Sperling)
3、	高分子材料加工工藝學，第 1 版，作者：鄔國銘，出版社：中國紡織出版社，2007
4、	高分子材料成型加工，3 版，唐頌超主編． 2013.5 (簡體)
